name: code-ontology-companion
description: A local code-to-ontology data pipeline with bounded multilingual analysis, typed policy knowledge, snapshot lineage and access-controlled local MCP, plus offline human HTML.

interface.longDescription: Analyze authorized code into immutable disk-partitioned knowledge with rule-attributed relationship evidence, adapter coverage limits, RDF 1.1 Turtle and a documented PROV-O subset. Python AST and conservative language adapters include Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash and explicitly partial additional languages. Restricted typed policies support source-free explanations and case comparisons; unsupported behavior stays unresolved. The complete package provides 19 read-only local MCP tools. Owner-default permissions separate structure, policy, evidence and exports using trusted local process bindings. Generated five-language offline HTML opens in the animated 3D workbench, with bounded map pages, linked catalogs, policy tables and text navigation. Deterministic analysis does not execute target code or make network requests. Static extraction is not runtime proof or business approval. Offline copies require independent file protection. Existing legacy workspaces and separately consented local inference remain compatible.
capabilities: Local code-to-ontology data pipeline with snapshot lineage
Current-conversation application with an actual first lookup
Capability-aware routing and authorized change checkpoints
Offline 3D structure, impact, and changes workbench
Exact symbol search and pinned snapshot reads
Directional static dependency paths with source evidence
Auditable relationship evidence and adapter coverage
Structural and relationship-evidence comparison
Selected portable code references and RDF export
Read-only local MCP search
Keyboard navigation and accessible paged text fallback
Optional consent-based local inference sidecars
Three display depths and one/two/three-hop call highlights
Complete indexed inventory through explicit expansion and pagination
Persistent source-root selection and duplicate-declaration detection
Pinned large-project module-catalog queries
Bounded static evidence bundles for source-backed answers
Local privacy checks for supported generated outputs
Disk-partitioned incremental pipeline with interrupted-run recovery
Static Bash analysis without executing scripts or expanding secrets
Typed policy queries from sealed knowledge without source rereads
Owner-default knowledge permissions and private portable exports
